shortDescription: Operate AEC applications with AUTOM8LABS MCP
longDescription: Operating guidance for Revit, AutoCAD, Navisworks, MicroStation, Dynamo, 3ds Max, Grasshopper and Unreal Engine. Requires the corresponding AUTOM8LABS connector and a client connection to the live host.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the connected Revit model without changing it.
Check the active AutoCAD drawing and its units.
List the connected AEC hosts and available capabilities.
